text.en:
Currency Act
Chapter 69
Pursuant to section 17(5) of the Currency Act, it is hereby notified for general information that the denomination and characteristics of the coin to be issued on 7th September 2004 by the Monetary Authority of Singapore are as shown in the Schedule.

THE SCHEDULE
DESCRIPTION OF THE BRUNEI ROYAL WEDDING $10000 COMMEMORATIVE COIN TO BE ISSUED ON 7TH SEPTEMBER 2004
Denomination
Metal
Standard Weight
Standard Diameter
Standard Thickness
Shape
Edge
Design of Obverse
Design of Reverse
10000 Dollars
999.9 Fine Gold
373.24 g + 3.00 g
65.00 mm ± 0.30 mm
6.50 mm ± 0.50 mm
Round
Milled and bearing the words “MONETARY AUTHORITY OF SINGAPORE” and lion symbol.
The Singapore Arms in the centre with the “$10000” denomination above it and the year-date “2004” below it. The word “SINGAPORE” in the 4 official languages around the circumference of the coin. The position of the mintmark is at 5 o’ clock.
The main feature of the coin is the portrait of the royal couple in the centre, with the words “DYTM PADUKA SERI PENGIRAN MUDA MAHKOTA PENGIRAN MUDA HAJI AL-MUHTADEE BILLAH AND DAYANGKU SARAH BINTI PENGIRAN SALLEH AB RAHAMAN” below it. At the circumference, the words “IN COMMEMORATION OF THE ROYAL WEDDING OF THE CROWN PRINCE OF BRUNEI DARUSSALAM” are above the portrait, and the wedding date “9 SEPTEMBER 2004” at the bottom.
(a)Reverse Design of the $10000 Gold Proof Coin.
(b)Obverse Design of the $10000 Gold Proof Coin.
